::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** June 17th 1893  
**From:** Elderfield Otterbourne Winchester  
**Manuscript:** MS UCLA: collection 100: box 95
:::

Dear Sir
I send you my own autograph, together with a few more, chiefly of authors.

If in return you could send me some stamps that have been through the post, local and the like, I should be much obliged.

Yours truly
C M Yonge

---

**Note:** On the other side of the card is pasted a photograph cut from a newspaper or magazine, captioned ‘Miss Charlotte M. Yonge. From a photograph by Messrs. Elliot & Fry, 55, Baker Street, W.’.
